access_control.claim_boundary: Netlify configuration proves deployment-level visitor access policy only; it does not prove application-level tenant isolation.

notes: The only discovered Freight deployment is the Netlify project above.
The only connected Supabase project discovered was Facility Bid Watch Validation, not Freight.
No Freight project was found in AppDeploy, Replit, Floot, Vercel, or Render.

cross_tenant_isolation.claim_boundary: SSO gating is not cross-tenant isolation. No customer database/object store/API authorization plane was discovered, so an A-vs-B tenant isolation test could not be executed.

parser_sandbox.claim_boundary: No production parser runtime could be tied to the Netlify deployment, so CPU/memory/time/network/credential sandboxing cannot be represented as proven.

observation_constraints.source_linkage_reason: No freightleak-audit linkage was found in the private ledger; the connected desktop that could contain local Netlify source metadata was offline.
observation_constraints.unauthenticated_black_box_probe_reason: Browser automation lacked credits; generic web access could not reach the protected host; container DNS resolution was unavailable.
observation_constraints.deployment_record_reason: A 24-character value inferred from the branch-version hostname returned 404 from the Netlify deploy reader and was discarded as evidence.

findings.title: Netlify team MFA is not enforced
Cross-tenant isolation is not proven
findings.evidence: No Freight customer data plane was discovered; zero dual-tenant negative probes were possible.

findings.title: Parser sandboxing is not proven
findings.evidence: No production parser runtime was discovered or linked to the Netlify deployment.

findings.title: Unauthenticated black-box SSO/access probe is not independently captured
findings.evidence: Platform configuration says SSO required for all, but independent HTTP/browser evidence could not be collected with available tools.
